activeSkill.name: Frozen Maelstorm
activeSkill.description:
After a brief charge-up, unleash a Frozen Maelstrom
forward, dealing [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage
to enemies in the area, applying Slow by 40%% and
reducing Attack Speed by 40%%, lasting 6s. The punch
also deals [Damage Rate: 300%] additional Magic
Damage to enemies directly in front and applies Frozen
for 3s.

passiveSkill.name: Fractured Ice
passiveSkill.description:
Gains 25% Damage Resistance if damage is dealt within
5, lasts for 6s. When taking damage during this time,
sends forth freezing air in all directions, dealing
[Damage Rate: 80%] Magic Damage to targets within
range, reducing Attack Speed by 30% and Movement
Speed by 30% for 4s. Minimum interval of 1s. (Cooldown:
20s)

activeSkill.name: Magma Slam
activeSkill.description:
Leaps to the target location. Gains immunity to control
during leap. Deals[Damage Rate: 350%] Physical
Damage and knocks enemies in the area up for 1.5s.

passiveSkill.name: Seismic Impact
passiveSkill.description:
When inflicting Immobilize or Hard Control (Stun, Fear,
Freeze, Knockup, Petrify), drops a meteor after 1s, dealing
480[Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage and 30% Slow
for 3s. (Cooldown: 5s)

activeSkill.name: Sandstorm Dominion
activeSkill.description:
Creates a Sandstorm around the caster, pushing all
enemies outside. Channels for 6s with +45% Damage
Resistance and control immunity. Enemies touching the
field take [Damage Rate: 300%] Physical Damage,
Slowed by 60% for 4s and dispelled from all buffs. Also knocks them
back 11m from center. The Sandstorm applies 60% Slow.

passiveSkill.name: Sand Veil
passiveSkill.description:
Creates a circular storm field around the caster for 4s
when causing Forced Movement (Pull, Knockback). Deals
[Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage to enemies in
field, inflicting Silence and a 40% chance to miss Basic
Attacks for 3s. (Cooldown: 20s)

activeSkill.name: Protector's Radiance
activeSkill.description:
Channel for 6s, gaining immunity to control. Allies on the
field gain +40% Max HP and immunity to Forced
Movement (Pull, Knockback). Each 5000 total damage
taken by allies grants 1 Energy stack, up to 5.
Use again within 12s of starting the channeling to
unleash absorbed energy, dealing [Damage Rate:
350%]-[Damage Rate: 700%] Magic Damage based on
stacks and reducing Movement Speed by 30% for 4s.

passiveSkill.name: Reflective Shield
passiveSkill.description:
Taking damage equal to 10% of Max HP within 5s after
skill cast grants 25% Damage Resistance for 6s. During
this time, reflect Magic Damage equal to 65% + 1.5% of
Max HP to the attacker. (Cooldown: 25s)

activeSkill.name: Shackled Grip
activeSkill.description:
Channel for 4s with control immunity and 30% increased
Movement Speed. On hit, deals [Damage Rate: 215%]
Physical Damage and creates a chain link (max 5 chains).
Chains break at range limit. After the channeling ends,
pull all chained targets to deal [Damage Rate: 215%]
Physical Damage and Stun them for 1.5s.

passiveSkill.name: Imprisonment
passiveSkill.description:
When inflicting Forced Movement (Pull, Knockback) on
enemies, creates a circular prison lasting 4s. Enemies
touching the prison take [Damage Rate: 100%] Magic
Damage and are Immobilized until the prison ends
(Cooldown: 20s)

activeSkill.name: Cannonade
activeSkill.description:
Transform into a turret for 25s. Basic Attacks become
artillery strikes, firing projectiles at targets beyond 8m,
dealing [Damage Rate: 250%] Physical Damage.
Artillery Critical Damage is 150%.
 While in turret form gain increased Magic Resistance

passiveSkill.name: Resolve
passiveSkill.description:
While standing still, gain 1 stack of [Steadfast] every
second.
[Steadfast]: +2% Critical Rate, +1.5% damage for 3s.
Stacks up to 15 times

activeSkill.name: Shield of Conviction
activeSkill.description:
Grants Shield of Conviction to up to 5 allies around the
caster for 6s. Allies with Shield of Conviction gain
[Target-based Max HP 30%] Shield effect, and 30% of
damage dealt will be converted into shield value, up to
[Target-based Max HP 15%] additional Shield. After 6s, if
the shield remains unbroken, deals [Damage Rate: 300%]
Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Subsequent
explosions deal reduced damage (15%).

passiveSkill.name: Defiant Resolve
passiveSkill.description:
Gains immunity to control effects and 20% Damage
Resistance whenever gaining shield for as long as the
shield remains. (Cooldown: 20s)

activeSkill.name: Skyward Leap
activeSkill.description:
Creates a protection zone at the target location that
grants allies within +30% Damage Resistance, +40%
Healing Received, +40% Dodge and heals for 
[Healing Rate: 50%] HP every second. Then leaps to the target
location, dealing [Damage Rate: 250%] Physical Damage
to those hit and knocking them up for 1s.
Immune to control during prep and leap.

passiveSkill.name: Healing Guardian
passiveSkill.description:
Gains 25% Damage Resistance for 1s if HP is below 75%.
Sends healing radiation waves in all directions, healing
allies in range for [Healing Rate: 50%] HP and granting
[Target-based Max HP 5%] Shield every 1s for 4s.
(Cooldown: 20s)

activeSkill.name: Acid Blast
activeSkill.description:
Sprays ooze for 4s, creating 4 ooze zones every second
that last 8.5s. Enemies in ooze zones are Slowed by 50%.
Enemies entering ooze zones gain [Acid Blast].

[Acid Blast]
Reduces Damage by 40% and cancels Stealth. Takes
[Damage Rate: 20%] Magic Damage every 1s per stack for
6s. Stacks up to 3 times.

passiveSkill.name: Corrosion Barrier
passiveSkill.description:
After taking 5 instances of damage, releases acid
outward, dealing [Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage to
enemies in range, reducing their damage dealt by 25% and
Movement Speed by 25% for 4s.

activeSkill.name: Flamecore Rampage
activeSkill.description:
Removes all current shield values, dealing 
[Damage Rate: 250%] Physical Damage to nearby enemies, while
also gaining 55% Attack Speed, 30% Movement Speed,
and 30% Critical Rate, and becoming Immune to Control
Effects for 6s.
 Can't be dispelled.

passiveSkill.name: Hell Salvo's Embrace
passiveSkill.description:
While without Armor, gains 5 Energy per second, and
gains 5 Energy on Basic Attack Crit. When Energy reaches
100, restores [Target-based Max HP 15%] Armor.
While with Armor, gains [Target-based Max HP 3%] Armor
on Basic Attack Crit. Armor restored cannot exceed
[Target-based Max HP 25%]. (Trigger Interval: a cooldown
of 1 seconds)

passiveSkill.name: Cyclone Reap
passiveSkill.description:
On Critical Hit, deals [Damage Rate: 70%] Physical
Damage to nearby enemies, while also reducing their
Armor by 15% for 4s. (Cooldown: 1.3s)

activeSkill.name: Spectral Disquise
activeSkill.description:
Creates a Spectral Disguise granting Stealth to the caster
and up to 15 nearby allies, increasing Damage Resistance
by 25% for 8s
Using a skill, dealing damage or inflicting healing breaks
Stealth for 4s before reapplying

passiveSkill.name: Echo Reflection
passiveSkill.description:
Skill and Basic Attack hits from the rear deal 
[Damage Rate: 60%] additional Physical Damage (Cooldown: 0.3s).
Basic Attack Damage Bonuses affect damage and basic
attack critical hits can cause the damage to crit.

activeSkill.name: Storm Pulse
activeSkill.description:
Activate an Electric Device for 8s.
Electric Device hits up to 5 enemies every 0.5s for
[Damage Rate: 40%] Physical Damage, reducing Armor by
8% for 8s. Stacks up to 10 times.

passiveSkill.name: Static Overdrive
passiveSkill.description:
Basic Attacks grant 1 stack of Electric Charge. At 5
stacks, the next attack triggers EMP Blast dealing
[Damage Rate: 160%] Physical Damage to enemies in
range.

activeSkill.name: Null Pulse
activeSkill.description:
Releases a Null Pulse in the target direction, dealing
 [Damage Rate: 50%] Physical Damage to enemies in
range, knocking them back 12m, and applying Silence and
40% Slow for 3s.

passiveSkill.name: Overclocking Reflex
passiveSkill.description: Has a 35% chance to dodge Basic Attack damage.

activeSkill.name: Soul Feast
activeSkill.description:
Creates a void field lasting 8s that envelops the caster
and up to 5 enemies, dealing 192[Damage Rate: 50%]
Magic Damage to enemies within. Enemies in the void are
immune to Physical Damage, cannot perform basic
attacks, are slowed for 30%, and have their Magic
Resistance reduced by 30%. The caster can still perform
basic attacks and gain 35% Basic Attack Lifesteal, while
also ignoring the Physical Damage immunity of enemies
in the void.

passiveSkill.name: Void Construct
passiveSkill.description:
Converts Physical Damage from Basic Attacks into Magic Damage. Each
time an attack deals damage, it reduces the target's Magic Resistance by 4%, for 4s, stacking up
to 10.

activeSkill.name: Shadow Dive
activeSkill.description:
Enters Stealth, gaining [Spectral Shield] and the ability
[Phantom Bind], lasting 9s.
Spectral Shield: Grants [Target-based Max HP 25%] shield
effect; if the Spectral Shield fades out, the Phantom Bind
effect ends prematurely.
Phantom Bind: Summon phantoms that track enemies in
range, dealing [Damage Rate: 183%] Magic Damage
and replenishing [Target-based Max HP 5%] Spectral
Shield.
Doesn't break Phantom Clone Stealth ..
Using any skill other than Phantom Bind, or dealing direct
healing or damage, reveals you for 2s before re-entering
Stealth.
Recovers 6% HP every 2s while in Stealth.

passiveSkill.name: Healing Bloom Hunter
passiveSkill.description:
Enters Stealth when standing still unhurt and not using
skills for a short duration. Damage, skills, or movement
breaks Stealth.
Warning when enemies are 7-14m away. Stealth breaks
after 3s within 7m.
Recovers 6% HP every 2s while in Stealth

activeSkill.name: Hemophage
activeSkill.description:
Activates Crimson Vortex for 6s.
Crimson Vortex deals [Damage Rate: 75%] Magical Damage to up to 5 enemies every second, healing the caster for 60% of damage dealt against players,
 30% versus monsters.
Damage increases up to [Damage Rate: 150%] as HP drops.

passiveSkill.name: Blood Contract
passiveSkill.description: Gains +4% Damage Resistance and +6% Attack Speed for every 10% HP lost.

activeSkill.name: Shadow Rift
activeSkill.description:
Creates a field around the caster, lasting 20s. Then
scatter 8 Shadow Clones, each dealing [Damage Rate:
200%] Physical Damage to those hit. Damage reduces to
15% for subsequent hits on the same target. While in the
field, skill changes to [Shadow Swap]. Touching a
Shadow Clone reduces Shadow Swap's cooldown by 5s,
grants [Target-based Max HP 10%] Shield and +20%
Movement Speed for 4s.
Field disappears when leaving range.
[Shadow Swap]: Dash forward and increase the Attack
Speed of the next 5 basic attacks within 6s by 60%.

passiveSkill.name: Umbra Kinetics
passiveSkill.description:
Grants Basic Attacks a 30% chance to trigger a shadow
strike for 6s, dealing [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical
Damage (Cooldown: 0.8s).
Basic Attack Damage Bonuses affect damage and basic
attack critical hits can cause the damage to crit.

activeSkill.name: Twinlance Infusion
activeSkill.description:
Creates a Lunar Domain and channels for 8s. Enemies
within are struck by starlight on skill use, taking 
[Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage and losing 20 MP. Allies
within recover 8 MP every second and gain 
[Target-based Max HP 15%] Shield lasting 4s.
Skill cannot be interrupted. +20% Movement Speed while
channeling.

passiveSkill.name: Lunar Rebirth
passiveSkill.description:
Every 2s restores Moonveil Max MP + 3% MP to other
allies within 12m

activeSkill.name: Shadow Cascade
activeSkill.description:
Channel void energy for 5s and send forth 37 Void Orbs,
each dealing [Damage Rate: 35%] Magic Damage and
inflicting [Void Toxin]
Skill cannot be interrupted.
[Void Toxin]: Deals [Damage Rate: 10%] Magic Damage
every second (increases based on stacks) for 12s,
stacking up to 5 times. [Void Toxin] from different sources
share stacks.

passiveSkill.name: Umbra Resonance
passiveSkill.description:
Gains 5% Movement Speed for 3s when inflicting an
enemy with a DoT effect, stacking up to 6 times.

activeSkill.name: Abyssal Sovereignty
activeSkill.description:
Removes all control effects and gains [Submerge] for
2.5s
[Submerge]: Dives underground, becoming immune to all
damage and control effects. Increases Movement Speed
by 40% and recovers[Healing Rate: 49%] HP every
second.
Press skill again to exit [Submerge] early.
Upon exiting [Submerge], deals [Damage Rate: 200%]
Magic Damage to nearby enemies.
Can be used while skills are disabled

passiveSkill.name: Hive Exaltation
passiveSkill.description:
Dealing damage with a skill grants 1 stack of Swarm,
restoring [Healing Rate: 7.5%] HP every 2s for 6s
(stacks do not boost healing effect). During this time,
Damage Resistance increases by 5%, stacking up to 5
times. (Cooldown: 0.5s)

activeSkill.name: Raven's Gaze
activeSkill.description:
Select an enemy target to summon ravens. After 2
seconds, ravens dive to attack, dealing [Damage Rate:
210%] Magic Damage to up to 10 enemies in range,
dispelling all buffs, shields, and HoT effects. Applies 50%
Slow and reduces damage dealt by 50% for 6s. Targets
cannot gain buffs, shields, or HoT effects during this time.

passiveSkill.name: Summon Raven
passiveSkill.description:
Skills dealing damage grant the caster Raven's Call. At 6
stacks, the next skill damage within 8s that hits an enemy
target will summon ravens at the location, dealing
[Damage Rate: 120%] Magic Damage to up to 5 enemy
targets in range. This effect removes 1 stack of buffs from
hit targets and restores [Healing Rate: 60%] HP to self.
(Trigger Interval: 0.5s)

activeSkill.name: Genetic Cascade
activeSkill.description:
Creates a Genetic Cascade link with the target, lasting
15s.
For allied targets: Restores [Healing Rate: 25%] HP every
second and increases damage dealt by 3% for 5s. Stacks
up to 10 times.
For enemy targets: Deals [Damage Rate: 50%] Magic
Damage every second and reduces damage dealt by 3%
for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.
Can link to another target of a different type while a link is
active.
Link breaks if the target moves over 25m away.

passiveSkill.name: Helical Convergence
passiveSkill.description:
After dealing damage 5 times, creates two Yin Vortexes
around the caster that deal [Damage Rate: 100%] Magic
Damage to enemies hit and reduce healing received by 5%
for 4s. Stacks up to 3 times. (Cooldown: 0.5s)
After healing 5 times, creates two Yang Vortexes around
self that restore [Healing Rate: 50%] HP to allies hit and
increase healing received by 5% for 4s. Stacks up to 3
times. (Cooldown: 0.5s)

activeSkill.name: Serpent's Whisper
activeSkill.description:
Applies Serpent's Whisper to the caster or an allied target,
preventing movement and skill usage for 4s and granting
immunity to damage and control. Deals [Damage Rate:
58%] Magic Damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s and
applies [Creeping Stone]
[Creeping Stone]: Lasts 1s, stacking up to 4 times. Target
is Petrified and has their Armor reduced by 25% for 2 at
max stacks (cannot gain [Creeping Stone] for 6)
Can be used while skills are disabled. Serpent's Whisper
cannot be dispelled.

passiveSkill.name: Shedskin
passiveSkill.description:
Retains 1 HP upon taking lethal damage, transforming
into a spirit serpent, cleansing all negative effects
(control, DoT, and debuffs), gaining immunity to control,
debuffs and damage for 2s, and +100% Movement Speed,
and healing 5% HP every 0.5s. (CD: 120s)

activeSkill.name: Bond of Light
activeSkill.description:
Links to 8 targets within 10m around the caster,
channeling for 4s. Restores [Healing Rate: 40%] HP to the
caster and linked allies every 0.5s, while dealing 
[Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage to linked enemies.
Cannot be interrupted while channeling.

passiveSkill.name: Light's Echo
passiveSkill.description: Other allies within 12m receive +20% healing.

activeSkill.name: Sanctification
activeSkill.description:
Creates an expanding Sanctification Field at the target
location and channels for 5s.
Cannot be interrupted while channeling.
Cleanses control effects every 0.5s, all debuffs, and 2 DoT
effects, from up to 20 allies in the field and restores
[Healing Rate: 25%] HP.

passiveSkill.name: Holy Covenant
passiveSkill.description:
When healing with skills, the target gains 5% additional
Damage Resistance for 4s. Stacks up to 6 times

activeSkill.name: Astral Gate
activeSkill.description:
Creates an astral field beneath the caster. After 3s,
teleports up to 15 teammates in range to the target
location. Upon arrival, deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic
Damage to surrounding enemies and Stuns them for 1s.
Allies gain [Target-based Max HP 20%] Shield, +30%
Movement Speed effects for 4s.
If there's unpassable terrain in the teleportation path,
teleport to that position instead ..
 Target cannot be teleported by Astral Gate for 10 seconds after teleportation.

passiveSkill.name: Celestial Rotation
passiveSkill.description:
Reduces the cooldown of all skills (not including Tactical
Item skills) by 0.3s when this skill deals damage.
(Cooldown: 0.5s)

activeSkill.name: Mole's Escape
activeSkill.description: Escape and trap enemy targets.

passiveSkill.name: Survivability Resilience
passiveSkill.description: Increases carrying weight limit.

core_skill.name: Bloom of Malice
core_skill.description:
Plants a Bloom of Malice seed before channeling energy
to it for 3s. The seed grows gradually until blooming
(press skill again to bloom early). When blooming, deals
[Damage Rate: 360%] Magic Damage to nearby enemies,
inflicts [Plague] based on growth time, and reduces Max
HP by 2.5% for 12s (stacks up to 10 times).
Effects increase with growth time ([Plague] stacks 1-2->
3-10 / Max HP stacks 1 ->10)

core_skill.name: Necrotic Eruption
core_skill.description:
Throws a device that generates Necromists randomly
within range every 3s (range gradually expands). Device
lasts 10s.
Necromists deal [Damage Rate: 60%] Magic Damage
every 2s, inflict [Plague], and reduce healing received by
5% for 12s, stacking up to 5 times.

core_skill.name: Sanctuary
core_skill.description:
Cleanses an ally or the caster of all Slow and Immobilize
effects, heals [Healing Rate: 300%] HP and grants
Sanctuary for 5s.
Sanctuary grants immunity to Slow and Immobilize, and
prevents HP from falling below 1. Each 10% of missing
HP increases healing received by 5%.
Sanctuary cannot be dispelled.

core_skill.name: Blessed Halo
core_skill.description:
Creates a Blessed Halo at the target location. After 1s,
heals all allies in range for [Healing Rate: 300%] HP,
cleanses all control effects and 5 debuffs, and grants
immunity to Control and Slow for 4s.

core_skill.name: Frost's Caller
core_skill.description:
Grants the power of arctic frost for 20s. Becomes immune
to Slows and Immobilize effects, and gains access to the
[Frost Slash] and [Frost Drift] skills.
-[Frost Slash]-
Launches ice blades forward that deal [Damage Rate:
110%] Magic Damage to enemies in their path, inflicting 1
stack of [Hypothermia] and reducing Movement Speed by
30% for 4s.
At 6 stacks of [Hypothermia], the target gains [Deep
Frost].
[Deep Frost]: Cannot attack or move for 1.5s.
-[Frost Drift] --
Instantly removes control effects and leaps in the target
direction.
[Deep Frost]: Cannot attack or move for 1.5s.

core_skill.name: Ice Blast
core_skill.description:
Creates a frost crystal at the target location that forms
after 0.7s, dealing [Damage Rate: 75%] Magic Damage
and Freezing enemies for 1.5s.
After 1s, the crystal shatters, dealing [Damage Rate:
400%] Magic Damage, and reducing Movement Speed by
40% and Attack Speed by 40% for 6s

core_skill.name: Molten Volley
core_skill.description:
Enter Molten Volley Mode for 20s. Cannot move while
active but can cancel manually.
Basic Attack replaced: Fires magma at the target location
that rolls forward after impact, dealing 
[Damage Rate: 90%] Magic Damage to those hit and inflicting 1 stack of
[Burn]. Damage increases by 10% after each enemy hit, up
to 40%.

core_skill.name: Starforge Beam
core_skill.description:
Channels a starforge beam for 4s after a 1s cast. Deals
[Damage Rate: 85%] Magic Damage to enemies in range
every 0.5s, inflicting 1 stack of [Burn] and [Scorch].
Each hit increases damage by 10%, up to 50%.
Cannot be interrupted during channeling and grants a
[Target-based Max HP 25%] shield.
[Scorch]: Reduces healing received by 5% for 4s. Stacks
up to 3 times.

core_skill.name: Crippling Curse
core_skill.description:
Channels for 0.5s to curse a circular area. After a brief
delay, deals [Damage Rate: 250%] Magic Damage to up to
10 enemies in range, dispeling all Buffs, shields, and HoT
effects, and inflicting [Crippled] for 6s.

[Crippled]
Cannot use movement skills or gain buffs, shields, or HoT
effects
Movement Speed Bonus: -50%

core_skill.name: Parasitic Swarm
core_skill.description:
Infects an enemy with [Parasites].
[Parasites]: Parasites last 12s and deal [Damage Rate: 50%] True Damage whenever the target takes direct
damage (minimum interval 0.8s). When dispelled, deals
[Damage Rate: 350%] Magic Damage

core_skill.name: Pestilence
core_skill.description:
Infects any target with Pestilence Source for 8s. Every
second, deals [Damage Rate: 65%] Magic Damage to the
infected and nearby enemies. Inflicts 1 stack of [Plague]
and reduces damage dealt by 5% to enemies except the
carrier for 4s, stacking up to 5 times.

core_skill.name: Hexbound Malice
core_skill.description:
Channels for 0.5s to inflict 2 stacks of [Plague] as well as
[Hexbound Malice] to enemies in range, lasting 9s.
[Hexbound Malice]: Each active skill used consumes 10
extra MP and inflicts [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic
Damage.

core_skill.name: Sacred Flare
core_skill.description:
Casts holy radiance at the target location. Heals allies in
range for [Healing Rate: 100%] HP and deals 
[Damage Rate: 300%] Magic Damage to enemies, knocking them
back 7m from the center. Gives enemies 60% chance to
miss Basic Attacks and reveals Stealth for 6s.

core_skill.name: Sanctified Domain
core_skill.description:
Creates a holy domain that deals [Damage Rate: 300%]
Magic Damage to enemies in range and knocks them back
10m. Channels for 3s, healing allies in range for 
[Healing Rate: 50%] HP every 0.5s and increasing their Damage
Resistance by 10% for 6s. Stacks up to 3 times.

core_skill.name: Sanctum Arc
core_skill.description:
Launches a Holy Chain that bounces to the nearest allied
target within 9 meters after hitting an ally, restoring
[Healing Rate: 100%] HP with each hit. It deals 
[Damage Rate: 100%] Magic Damage to up to 5 enemy targets in
range, with damage reduced to 20% for subsequent
explosions.
The chain can bounce up to 9 times, and each target can
be hit a maximum of 3 times.

core_skill.name: Divine Vault
core_skill.description:
Leaps to the target location. Upon landing, deals
Damage Rate: 300%] Magic Damage to enemies in range
and knocks them up for 0.75s. Heals allies in range for
[Healing Rate: 150%] HP and increases their Dodge by
30% for 6s.

core_skill.name: Frozen Phase
core_skill.description:
Launches a frost orb in the target direction that deals
[Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage every second and
reduces Movement Speed by 40% for 3s to enemies in
range. Within 3s, can recast to blink to the orb's location,
dealing [Damage Rate: 250%] Magic Damage and
Freezing nearby enemies for 1.5s.

core_skill.name: Frost Nova
core_skill.description:
Places a Frost Nova at the target location, lasting 15s.
When triggered by an enemy, deals [Damage Rate: 250%]
Magic Damage and reduces Movement Speed by 35% and
15% reduced healing for 6s.
Gains 1 charge every 15s, up to 3 charges

core_skill.name: Frostbound Echo
core_skill.description:
Launches ice in the target direction. Upon hitting an
enemy, it splits into 3 ice shards that bounce between
nearby enemies up to 5 times. Each target can be hit up to
3 times.
Each hit deals [Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage and
reduces Attack Speed by 15% for 4s. Stacks up to 3 times.

core_skill.name: Frostbite
core_skill.description:
Creates a freezing cyclone at the target location, lasting
5s. Enemies inside are Slowed by 60% and take 
[Damage Rate: 90%] Magic Damage every second.

core_skill.name: Hell Salvo
core_skill.description:
After a 1s cast, channels for 3s, continuously firing at
target. Each projectile deals [Damage Rate: 45%] Magic
Damage to enemies hit, inflicts 1 stack of [Burn], and
reduces Magic Resistance by 8% for 4s. Stacks up to 6
times.

core_skill.name: Core Flare
core_skill.description:
Launches 3 Core Flare orbs at the target location. Each
nova deals [Damage Rate: 180%] Magic Damage to
enemies hit and inflicts 1 stack of [Burn] and 1 stack of
[Scorch]. Additional novas hitting the same target deal
30% reduced damage.
Gains 1 charge every 15s, up to 3 charges.
[Scorch]: Reduces healing received by 5% for 4s. Stacks
up to 3 times

core_skill.name: Scorching Surge
core_skill.description:
After a 1s cast, launches three scorching surges at the
target location. After 1s, the flames erupt, each dealing
Damage Rate: 240%] Magic Damage and inflicting 1
stack of [Burn] and Knockup for 1s to enemies in range.
Damage reduces to 50% for enemies that take damage
from more than one scorching surge.

core_skill.name: Molten Blast
core_skill.description:
Fires a Molten Blast in target direction that explodes on
impact, dealing [Damage Rate: 150%] Magic Damage to
enemies in range and inflicting 1 stack of [Burn].
Can be charged. At 3s charge time, the Molten Blast can
penetrate enemies along its path, dealing [Damage Rate:
50%] Magic Damage and exploding at the end point to
deal [Damage Rate: 250%] Magic Damage, inflicting 2
stacks of [Burn], and applying Knockback to enemies
within the explosion range by 3m.
Gains 1 charge every 18s, up to 2 charges.

core_skill.name: Rot Manifest

When taking damage at below 30% HP, immediately
restores [Healing Rate: 40%] HP every second for 5s.
Trigger Interval: 60s

core_skill.name: Panic
core_skill.description:
Creates a panic curse field around the caster that lasts
6s
Enemies within 6m who use skills take [Damage Rate:
200%] Magic Damage and are affected by Fear for 1.5s

core_skill.name: Barrier
core_skill.description:
Gains a [Target-based Max HP 45%] shield for 6s. While
the shield exists, restores 20 MP each time taking
damage.

core_skill.name: Mana Font
core_skill.description:
Creates a 7m radius Mana Font around the caster, lasting 6s
Restores 10 MP to allies in range every 1s
Increases casting speed of friendly units within by 80%

core_skill.name: Repulse
core_skill.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage to nearby
enemies, disarms them for 4s and knocks them back 10m, and reduces their
Movement Speed by 40% for 4s.

core_skill.name: Dispel
core_skill.description:
Launches a dispel projectile that deals [Damage Rate:
120%] Magic Damage to enemies in the impact area,
removes all buffs and Shield effects. Reduces target's physical damage dealt by 40%

core_skill.name: Purify
core_skill.description:
Immediately removes all control effects, restores 
[Healing Rate: 150%] HP, and grants Control Immunity for 2s.
Can be used while skills are disabled

core_skill.name: Heal
core_skill.description:
Instantly restores [Healing Rate: 100%] HP to nearby
allies.

core_skill.name: Heal
core_skill.description:
Instantly restores [Healing Rate: 100%] HP to nearby
allies.

core_skill.name: Vulnerability
core_skill.description: Increases Damage Resistance by 30% and creates a weakening field around the caster, lasting 6s. Enemies within 7m deal 80% less damage and cannot enter Stealth.

core_skill.name: Converge
core_skill.description: Creates a converging force field. After 1.5s, deals Damage Rate: 250%] Physical Damage to enemies within 7m, pulls them to the center, Stuns them for 0.5s, and Slows them by 30% for 4s.

core_skill.name: Shield
core_skill.description: Grants a shield with [Target-based Max HP 20%] Shield Value to nearby allies for 6s. When HP is below 40%, the Shield Value increases to [Target-based Max HP 35%].

core_skill.name: Stun
core_skill.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 300%] Physical Damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 1.5s and reducing their Speed by 40% for 4s.

core_skill.name: Charge
core_skill.description: Sounds a war horn, lasting 5s. Allies within 7m gain 30% Damage Resistance, 50 Control Resistance, and immunity to Forced Movement effects (Knockback, Pull).

core_skill.name: Root Grip
core_skill.description: Shoots a grappling rope that deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage to the target, Immobilizes them for 2s, and pulls both toward the middle.

core_skill.name: Block
core_skill.description: Channels for 2.5s, increasing Damage Resistance by 90%. Can move during channeling but Speed is reduced by -90%

core_skill.name: Block
core_skill.description: Channels for 2.5s, increasing Damage Resistance by 90%. Can move during channeling but Speed is reduced by -90%

core_skill.name: Rally
core_skill.description:
Creates a Rally aura around the caster, lasting 9s
Allies within 7m gain +30% Attack Speed and +30%
Cooldown Speed

core_skill.name: Armor Breaker
core_skill.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage to nearby
enemies, reduces their Damage Resistance by 20% for 6s
and increases own damage by 15% for 6s

core_skill.name: Snarl
core_skill.description:
Snarls toward the target direction, dealing [Damage Rate:
200%] Physical Damage to enemies in range. Reduces
their Movement Speed by 40%, damage dealt by 50%, and
disables Stealth for 5s

core_skill.name: Finisher
core_skill.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 100%] True Damage to nearby
enemies. Damage increases by 15% for every 10% HP the
target is missing.

core_skill.name: Reflect
core_skill.description:
Increases Damage Resistance by 30% for 6s. During this
time, reflects 100% of damage taken as Magic Damage to
the attacker.

core_skill.name: Smoke Screen
core_skill.description:
Creates a 12m smoke screen, lasting 6s. Enter Stealth for
6s. Every 0.5s in the smoke screen grants 1 stack of +60%
Attack Speed for the next Basic Attack, lasting 6s. Stacks
up to 8 times.
Using a skill, causing direct healing or damage, or leaving
the smoke clears the smoke and removes stealth.

core_skill.name: Bandage
core_skill.description:
Channel for 5s, recovering [Healing Rate: 70%] HP every
second.
Can move slowly while channeling

core_skill.name: Bandage
core_skill.description:
Channel for 5s, recovering [Healing Rate: 70%] HP every
second.
Can move slowly while channeling

core_skill.name: Berserk
core_skill.description:
Increases Movement Speed by 70% and damage by 20%
for 6s.
When effect ends, reduces Damage Resistance by 15% for 4s

core_skill.name: Ghost
core_skill.description:
After 1.5s cast time, enters Ghost Form, increases
Movement Speed by 70% and becomes immune to
damage and control effects for 4s. Cannot cast other
skills or attack while in Ghost form.

core_skill.name: Flash Step
core_skill.description:
Move 12m in target direction. Restore [Healing Rate:
150%] HP and 20 MP.

core_skill.name: Frost
core_skill.description:
Increases Movement Speed by 55% for 5s. Creates a frost
path that lasts 4s. Enemies in the path are slowed by 40%
and their Attack Speed is reduced by 45% for 2s.

core_skill.name: Decay
core_skill.description:
Increases Movement Speed by 55%, lasting 5s; creates a
path of corruption lasting 4s along movement path.
Enemies in the path suffer 35% reduced damage dealt and
30% reduced healing received for 5s.

core_skill.name: Displacement
core_skill.description:
Grants a [Target-based Max HP 25%] shield lasting 4s and
swaps positions with target player.

core_skill.name: Abundance
core_skill.description:
Increases Movement Speed by 50% and restores 8 MP
every second for 5s.

core_skill.name: Lunge
core_skill.description: Charges forward 5 times, dealing [Damage Rate: 50%]. Physical Damage to enemies in path and knocking them back 4m each time. If knocked into terrain, enemies are stunned for 2s. Immune to control effects and gains +80% Damage. Resistance while charging.

core_skill.name: Mountain Crash
core_skill.description: Leaps to the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage and inflicting Knockup for 1s to enemies upon landing. Then adjusts direction and leaps again toward the target, dealing another [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage and inflicting Knockup for 1s on enemies upon landing. During the skill's duration, immune to control effects and gains +80% Damage Resistance.

core_skill.name: Vengeance
core_skill.description: For every 10% HP lost, gains 1 stack of Movement Speed Increase by 17.5% and damage by 4.5% for 5s. Stacks up to 7 times.

core_skill.name: Guardian
core_skill.description: Leap to the target location. Upon landing, grants [Target-based Max HP 22%] Shield to nearby allies for 6s.

core_skill.name: Titanic Growth
core_skill.description: Enhances Movement Speed by 30%, Max HP and Current HP by 80%, and grants Immunity to Forced Movement (Pull, Knockback) for 6s.

core_skill.name: Vanguard
core_skill.description: Remove Slow and immobilize effects. Increases Movement Speed by 80% and gains immunity to Slow and immobilize effects for 4s.

core_skill.name: Vitality
core_skill.description: Increases Movement Speed by 50% and restores [Healing Rate: 20%] HP every second for 5s.

core_skill.name: Escape
core_skill.description:
Remove control effects and dash toward target direction.
Gain Control Immunity for 2s.
Can be used while skills are disabled

core_skill.name: Phase Shift
core_skill.description:
Leave a mark at current position and dash to the target
location. Upon arrival, deal [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical
Damage to enemies in range and reduce their Damage
Resistance by 15% for 4s. Can be cast again within 5
seconds to return to original position and gain 40%
Movement Speed for 3s.

core_skill.name: Attack Speed
core_skill.description:
Increases Movement Speed by 60% and Attack Speed by
45% for 6s.

core_skill.name: Grace
core_skill.description:
Dashes 6m in target direction. Gains 15% Critical Rate for
5s. Stacks up to 2 times.
Can be used again within 4s.

core_skill.name: Assassinate
core_skill.description:
Quickly dash behind target, dealing [Damage Rate: 150%]
Physical Damage and increasing Basic Attack Damage by
40% for 6s.
Gains 1 charge every 20s, up to 2 charges

core_skill.name: Vanish
core_skill.description:
Increases Movement Speed by 30%, enters Stealth after
1s, gaining +60% Movement Speed for 4s.
Using a skill, dealing damage or inflicting healing breaks
Stealth

core_skill.name: Sidestep
core_skill.description:
Step 9m toward target direction. Increases Movement
Speed by 40% for 4s.

jump_cleave.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Jump Cleave] every 6s. Performs a powerful leap attack, dealing [Damage Rate: 220%] Physical Damage and reducing Armor by 15% for 4s

cleaving_strike.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 160%] Physical Damage to enemies in a frontal cone

cyclone_slash.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Cyclone Slash] every 5s. Deals [Damage Rate: 240%] Physical Damage to nearby enemies and reduces the healing they receive by 15% for 4s.

tempest_strike.description: Channels for 3s. Damage Resistance is increased by 25% while channeling. Deals [Damage Rate: 90%] Physical Damage to players ([Damage Rate: 135%] Physical Damage to mobs) every 0.4s. On completion, deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Channeling can be ended early to perform the final strike

rock_smash.description: Swings a giant axe to perform Rock Smash, dealing Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage and 1.2s Stunning enemies before the caster. Stones deal [Damage Rate: 50%] Physical Damage to those hit and [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage on landing, also inflicting 30% Slow for 4s.

primal_rush.description: Charges forward to deal [Damage Rate: 30%] Physical Damage to up to 5 enemies hit, continuously knocking them back. The final impact deals [Damage Rate: 160%] Physical Damage to enemies in range. Fury

axehook.description: Swings an axehook forward to pull up to 5 enemies to the caster, also deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage and inflicts 50% Slow for 4s.

rage.description: Removes control effects and increases Attack Speed by 40%, damage by 15%, and Movement Speed by 30% for 6s.

passive_skill.name: Bloodthrist
passive_skill.description: Against marked targets restore 6% of missing HP, deal +5% extra damage, while also granting +10% Attack Speed and +8% Movement Speed for 4s. Stacks up to 3 times. Consumes Bloodthirst Mark when triggered.

split_arrow.description:
Replaces Basic Attack with [Split Arrow].
Deals [Damage Rate: 80%] Physical Damage to up to 5
enemies in a frontal cone

piercing_arrow.description:
Fires an arrow forward, dealing [Damage Rate: 170%]
Physical Damage and reducing Armor by 10% for 4s to all
enemies hit.
Range increases with charge time

venom_arrow.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 80%] Physical
Damage to the target.

Every 6th Basic Attack becomes [Venom Arrow].
Deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage and inflicts
Venom.

[Venom]
Deals [Damage Rate: 15%] Magic Damage every second
for 6s. Stacks up to 3 times

blast_arrow.description:
Gains 10 explosive arrows for 12s.
When Basic Attacks or skill arrows hit enemies, deal
[Damage Rate: 40%] Physical Damage to up to 5 nearby
enemies

frost_arrow.description:
Gains 10 frost arrows for 12s.
Basic Attacks and skill arrows deal [Damage Rate: 50%]
additional Physical Damage and inflict 40% Slow for 2s
on hit.

sleep_arrow.description:
Fires a sleep arrow forward while self-knockback 14m. Deals [Damage Rate:
200%] Physical Damage on first enemy hit and applies Sleep for 5 seconds.

silencing_arrow.description:
Fires a silencing arrow forward. The first enemy hit takes
[Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage. After 2s, the
arrow inflicts [Damage Rate: 180%] additional Magic
Damage and applies Silence for 3s to enemies within 5m.

binding_arrow.description:
Fires three binding arrows forward. The first player hit by
each takes [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage
([Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage to mobs) and is
Immobilized for 1.5s.
Gains 1 charge every 14s, up to 2 charges.

passive_skill.name: Target Mark
passive_skill.description:
When dealing weapon skill damage, applies [Target Mark]
for 8s. After dealing Basic Attack Damage 3 times to a
marked target, deals [Damage Rate: 90%] additional
Physical Damage, inflicts 25% Slow for 2s, and increases
Movement Speed by 25% for 2s, also grants the next 2
Basic Attacks +60% Attack Speed for 6s. Basic Attack
Damage Bonuses affect damage and basic attack critical
hits can cause the damage to crit.
Removes [Target Mark] after triggering.

touch_of_plague.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 90%] Magic Damage and applies
[Plague].

plague_strike.description:
Casts for 1.2s, releasing a shockwave in the target
direction; deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Magic Damage to
enemies in its path and applies [Plague].

venom_pool.description:
Throws a pool of venom at the target location, lasting 3s,
slowing enemies inside by 20% and inflicting [Plague]
every second.

scourge.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 125%] Magic Damage to target every
0.7s, inflicts [Plague], and restores [Healing Rate: 25%]
HP
Cannot move while channeling.

plague_surge.description:
Releases a plague surge in target direction, dealing
[Damage Rate: 160%] Magic Damage to enemies hit,
inflicting 2 stacks of [Plague] and reducing Speed by 30%
for 4s.

spread_plague.description:
While active, consumes 15 MP every 3s and inflicts
[Plague] to nearby enemies. Basic Attacks have a 30%
chance to miss for 9s.
Use again to deactivate. Automatically deactivates when
MP is insufficient.

exhaustion.description:
Summons a draining field at the target location, lasting
6s. Slows enemies inside by 30% and inflicts [Exhaustion]
every 1s for 6s, stacking up to 6 times.

[Exhaustion]
Damage Boost: -6% (-6% per stack, can stack)
Healing Bonus: -6% (-6% per stack, can stack)
Attack Speed: -6% (-6% per stack, can stack)

toxic_matter.description:
Casts for 0.5s, launching Toxic Matter at the target. Upon
hitting an enemy, it bounces to other enemies within 7m
up to 9 times. Each target can be hit up to 2 times.
Each hit deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Magic Damage and
inflicts 1 stack of Plague and reduces Magic Resistance
by 15% for 4s.

passive_skill.name: Plague Outbreak
passive_skill.description:
[Plague]: Deals [Damage Rate: 20%] Magic Damage every
3s for 13s. Stacks up to 10 times.
When a target affected by [Plague] dies, deals 
[Damage Rate: 120%] Magic Damage to up to 5 other nearby
enemies.

bleeding_thrust.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical
Damage and applies 1 stack of [Bleed].

Can cast [Bleeding Thrust] every 6s.
Dash toward an enemy target, dealing [Damage Rate:
160%] Physical Damage and inflicting 2 stacks of [Bleed]

ricocheting_blades.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical
Damage and applies 1 stack of [Bleed].

Can cast [Ricochet] every 6s.
Throws a blade at the target that deals [Damage Rate:
120%] Physical Damage, inflicts 1 stack of [Bleed], and
reduces their Movement Speed by 40% for 2s. After which
it bounces to 1 enemy behind up to 4 times

armor_breaker.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical
Damage and applies 1 stack of [Bleed].

Can cast [Armor Breaker] every 5s.
Deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage to nearby
enemies, inflicting 1 stack of [Bleed], and reducing their
Armor by 15% for 4s.

whirling_blades.description:
Throws 3 blades forward. Each blade deals 
[Damage Rate: 80%] Physical Damage to all enemies hit. Upon
reaching max range, the blades return, dealing 
[Damage Rate: 80%] Physical Damage to those hit and inflicting 1
stack of [Bleed]
Multiple blade hits on the same target beyond the first
deal 30% reduced damage

phase_blade.description:
Dashes 3m backward while firing a Phase Blade forward
that deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage to the
first enemy hit, inflicting 1 stack of [Bleed] and Stunning
for 0.75s, while also marking them for 5s.
Recast the skill within 15m while a mark exists to
instantly appear behind the target, dealing [Damage Rate:
160%] Physical Damage and gaining +30% Attack Speed
for 5s

crippling_strike.description:
Strike an enemy twice, dealing [Damage Rate: 180%]
Physical Damage, applying 1 stack of [Bleed] and
Disarming them for 4s. Increases Basic Attack Damage by
25% for 5s.

smoke_grenade.description:
Throws a smoke grenade to create a smoke screen for 6s.
Enemies inside are Slowed by 40% and have a 55% chance
to miss Basic Attacks. Also deals [Damage Rate: 25%]
Physical Damage every second

shadow_move.description:
Instantly removes control effects and enters Stealth.
While in Stealth, gains immunity to movement-limiting
effects (Slow, Immobilize) for 2s. Also increases damage
by 7% for 6s, stacking up to 2 times.
Can be recast once within 6s, but doing so will not remove
control effects again.
Using a skill, dealing damage or inflicting healing breaks
Stealth

passive_skill.name: Bleed
passive_skill.description:
Dealing damage inflicts [Bleed], dealing [Damage Rate:
30%] Physical Damage every second for 8s, stacking up to
6 times (stacks do not boost damage).
At max stacks, triggers Hemorrhage, dealing 
[Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage + True Damage equal to 4%
of the target's current HP and removes all [Bleed] stacks.
Basic Attack Damage Bonuses affect the base damage
and basic attack critical hits can cause the damage to
crit.

magma_burst.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 120%] Magic Damage and applies 1
stack of [Burn].

scorching_shard.description:
After 1.2s cast, fires 3 scorching shards in the target
direction, dealing [Damage Rate: 120%] Magic Damage to
enemies hit and inflicting 1 stack of [Burn]. When multiple
shards hit the same target, additional shards deal 25%
less damage to the original damage.

wildfire_shard.description:
After 2s cast, fires a wildfire shard at the target location
that bounces forward twice. Explodes on contact with
enemies, dealing [Damage Rate: 120%] Magic Damage
and inflicting 1 stack of [Burn] to enemies in range

inferno_blast.description:
Continuously channels flames in target direction for 3s,
dealing [Damage Rate: 50%] Magic Damage and inflicting
Burn] to all enemies in range every 0.5s.
Can rotate but cannot move while channeling
75% Increased Damage against Monsters

molten_orb.description:
Channels for 0.5s and then launches a molten orb in
target direction that sticks to the first enemy hit, lasting
5s and dealing [Damage Rate: 110%] Magic Damage to
enemies within 5m every 2s while inflicting 1 stack of
[Burn].

blast_jump.description:
Jumps in target direction, dealing [Damage Rate: 250%]
Magic Damage and inflicting 2 stacks of [Burn] to nearby
enemies upon takeoff.

oil_blast.description:
Sprays oil lasting 8s in front, inflicting [Oil Coating] to
enemies who enter.
[Oil Coating]: Reduces Movement Speed by 50% for 4s.
When affected by [Burn], [Oil Coating] is replaced with
[Volatile Burn] and cannot be inflicted again for 6s.
[Volatile Burn]: Causes Fear and deals [Damage Rate:
56%] Magic Damage every 0.5s for 1.5s.

overdrive_mode.description:
Activates Overdrive Mode, increasing Casting Speed by
60% and Magic Damage by 20%.
Consumes 5 MP every second.
Use skill again to deactivate Overdrive. Automatically
deactivates when MP is insufficient

passive_skill.name: Burst
passive_skill.description:
Damage dealt inflicts [Burn], dealing [Damage Rate: 25%]
Magic Damage every second for 8s, stacking up to 6 times
(stacks do not boost damage).
When [Burn] reaches max stacks, deals [Damage Rate:
80%] Magic Damage to up to 5 enemies near the carrier
and removes all [Burn] stacks.

ice_burst.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 90%] Magic Damage.

Can cast [Ice Burst] every 5s.
Deals [Damage Rate: 150%] Magic Damage to the target
and Immobilizes them for 1.5s

frostbite_zone.description:
Creates a zone of deep frost in the target direction,
dealing [Damage Rate: 130%] Magic Damage to enemies
in range and reducing their Movement Speed by 25% for
4s

frost_burst.description:
Launches three frost shards in the target direction after a
delay, each dealing [Damage Rate: 110%] Magic Damage
to enemies hit. The damage from shards beyond the first
is reduced by 25%.

frost_beam.description:
Channels for 3s, continuously firing a frost beam in the
target direction that deals [Damage Rate: 60%] Magic
Damage to players ([Damage Rate: 120%] Magic Damage
to mobs) every 0.5s to those hit and inflicts [Frost Beam
Slow] for 3s, stacking up to 5 times.

[Frost Beam Slow]
Movement Speed Bonus: -8% (-8% per stack, can stack)

crystal_frost.description:
Launches crystalline frost in the target direction. Upon
hitting the first enemy, it explodes to deal [Damage Rate:
250%] Magic Damage and Immobilize enemies in range
for 2s.

frost.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage to nearby
enemies and Freezes them for 0.5s, then blinks in the
target direction.

frost_wall.description:
Creates a frost wall before the caster that lasts 8s.
Enemies inside are Slowed by 70%, take [Damage Rate:
50%] Magic Damage every second, and gain [Chill] stacks.
Stacks up to 2 times.
[Chill]: At max stacks, targets are Frozen for 1.5s and
become immune to [Chill] for 6s.

frost_roar.description:
Unleashes a freezing roar in the target direction, dealing
[Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage and knocking
enemies back 10m. Reduces Movement Speed by 30% and
Attack Speed by 30% for 4s.

passive_skill.name: Passive
passive_skill.description:
After not taking damage for 15s, gains [Target-based Max
HP 20%] Shield. When hit by Basic Attacks, applies [Frost]
to the attacker.
[Frost]: Reduces Attack Speed and Movement Speed by
40% for 4s, gradually weakening over time.

headshot.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 60%] Physical Damage to the target. Every 4th Basic Attack becomes [Headshot]. Deals [Damage Rate: 112%] Physical Damage and always crits

ricochet.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 60%] Physical Damage to the target. Can cast [Ricochet] every 6s. Deals [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical Damage and applies 30% Slow for 4s. Bounces to 1 enemy behind the target up to 4 times

armor_break.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 60%] Physical Damage to the target. Can cast [Armor Break] every 7s. Deals [Damage Rate: 180%] Physical Damage and reduces Armor by 10% for 4s to all enemies hit

trap.description: Places a trap at the target location that lasts 150s. When enemies enter its range, reveals Stealth for 2s and grants a [Target-based Max HP 15%] Shield for 4s. Creates a slowing field, reducing enemy Speed by 35%. After 2s, explodes to deal [Damage Rate: 180%] Physical Damage to players ([Damage Rate: 270%] Physical Damage to mobs). Gains 1 charge every 15s, up to 2 charges

quick_load.description: Steps 6m in the target direction. The next 4 Basic Attacks gain +80% Attack Speed and +25% damage for 6s. Loads 1 bullet. Gains 1 charge every 16s, up to 2 charges.

concussion_grenade.description: Throws a powerful grenade at the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 180%] Physical Damage and knocking enemies back 6m from the center. Reduces Attack Speed by 30% and Movement Speed by 40% for 4s. If within blast radius, the user is pushed back 6m

blinding_flash.description: Throws a flash grenade to the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage to enemies in range, revealing Stealth, and giving Basic Attacks a 45% chance to miss for 6s.

aim.description: Enters Aim mode. Increases Basic Attack Damage by 40% and range by 6m. Reduces Movement Speed by 65%. Use again to exit Aim mode

passive_skill.name: Reload
passive_skill.description: Gun holds up to 6 bullets. While not using skills: If at 0 bullets, reload instantly. Otherwise, reload 4s after skill use. Each bullet increases reload time by 0.5s. Cannot interrupt reload

holy_feather.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 90%] Magic Damage.

Can cast [Holy Feather] every 5s.
Deals [Damage Rate: 150%] Magic Damage to the target
and heals [Healing Rate: 75%] HP for up to 3 allies within
14m

holy_smite.description:
After a 0.5s cast, calls down holy smite at the target
location, dealing [Damage Rate: 80%] Magic Damage to
all players ([Damage Rate: 160%] Magic Damage to
mobs). Heals the caster for [Healing Rate: 48%] HP if
hitting at least one enemy.

holy_heal.description:
After a 1.5s cast, performs holy healing at the target
location, restoring [Healing Rate: 90%] HP allies in range.

holy_wave.description:
Projects a holy wave in the target direction, dealing
[Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage to all players
([Damage Rate: 300%] Magic Damage to mobs) in its
path. The wave automatically returns when reaching max
range, healing up to 5 nearby allies for [Healing Rate:
75%] HP.

divine_link.description:
Channels divine link on target for 6s, also granting the
caster [Target-based Max HP 15%] Shield for 4s. Can
move slowly while channeling.
When targeting an ally, heals them for [Healing Rate:
100%] HP every second.
When targeting an enemy, deals [Damage Rate: 100%]
Magic Damage every second.

holy_energy.description:
Projects holy energy at the target location. On impact,
restores [Healing Rate: 75%] HP and grants a
[Target-based Max HP 20%] shield for 4s to allies in
range.

holy_wall.description:
Creates multiple holy walls in front. Enemies who touch
them take [Damage Rate: 150%] Magic Damage and are
stunned for 1.5s, while the caster gains 
[Target-based Max HP 12%] Shield for 6s, stacking up to 4 times.

holy_baptism.description:
Cleanses all Slow and Immobilize effects and 2 Debuff
effects from the caster and up to 20 nearby allies and
restores [Healing Rate: 100%] HP. Also prevents the next 3
Immobilize and Immune to Slow effects within 4s.

passive_skill.name: Divine Ward
passive_skill.description: Increases the resistances of allies within 9m by 15%

swing.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 120%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Swing] every 4s. Deals [Damage Rate: 240%] Physical Damage to all players ([Damage Rate: 480%] Physical Damage to mobs) in a frontal cone

smash.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 120%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Smash] every 7s. Deals [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage to enemies in range and restores [Healing Rate: 75%] HP to up to 5 nearby allies. Increases Damage Resistance by 15% for 6s.

crushing_smash.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 120%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Crushing Smash] every 6s. Charges toward target, dealing [Damage Rate: 160%] Physical Damage to enemies in range and inflicting Slow 35% for 3s

frenzied_smash.description: Smashes the ground 4 times. The first three hits deal [Damage Rate: 120%] Physical Damage to players ([Damage Rate: 180%] Physical Damage to mobs). The final hit deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage to players ([Damage Rate: 300%] Physical Damage to mobs) and Knocks Up for 0.5s.

binding_smash.description: Leaps to the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage and inflicting Immobilize for 2.5s to enemies in the area.

guardian_field.description: Creates a Guardian Field at the target location that increases allies' Max HP by 25% and grants Immunity to Forced Movement (Pull, Knockback) and Hard Control (Stun, Fear, Freeze, Knockup, Petrify, Sleep). Lasts 5s.

field_of_silence.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage to enemies in range and creates a Field of Silence, lasting 4s. Enemies in the field are Slowed by 25% and Silenced. Once they leave the area, they become immune to the field's Silence for 6s.

vengeful_thunder.description: Applies [Vengeful Thunder] to the caster or an allied target [Vengeful Thunder]: Increases Damage Resistance by 25% for 8s. When taking damage or dealing Basic Attack Damage, calls down lightning at the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 51%] Physical Damage. (Cooldown: 0.8s)

passive_skill.name: Guardian
passive_skill.description: Guardian Passive Using a weapon skill increases Damage Resistance by 30% and Control Resistance by 35 for 6s.

evil_seed.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 80%] Magic Damage.

Throws an [Evil Seed] after 5 Basic Attacks.
Throws an Evil Seed at the target location, creating a
thorn zone that lasts 5s. The zone deals [Damage Rate:
40%] Magic Damage every second to up to 5 enemies and
reduces their Movement Speed by 25%.

soothing_mist.description:
Releases Soothing Mist in the target direction, dealing
[Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage to enemies hit, while
applying 1 stack of [Recovery] to allies.
[Recovery]: Restores HP every second for 12s, stacking up
to 3 times.
HP recovery at 1 | 2 | 3 stacks:
[Healing Rate: 10%] | [Healing Rate: 15%] | [Healing Rate:
20%]

healing_seed.description:
Throws a healing seed at the target location that blooms,
healing nearby allies for [Healing Rate: 55%] HP and
applying 1 stack of [Recovery]
[Recovery]: Restores HP every second for 12s, stacking up
to 3 times.
HP recovery at 1 | 2 | 3 stacks:
[Healing Rate: 10%] | [Healing Rate: 15%] | [Healing Rate:
20%]

winding_vines.description:
After a brief delay, creates an entangling zone lasting 4s.
Deals [Damage Rate: 90%] Magic Damage every second
and immobilizes enemies that enter for 1.5s.

energize.description:
Creates an energizing aura around the caster, lasting 5s.
Restores [Healing Rate: 39%] HP and 12 MP every second
to up to 10 nearby allies.

vitality_seed.description:
Applies Vitality Seeds to up to 5 nearby allies, healing for
[Healing Rate: 80%] HP and applying 1 stack of
[Recovery].
Vitality Seeds increase Cast Speed by 40% and
Attack Speed by 25% for 6s.
[Recovery]: Restores HP every second for 12s, stacking up
to 3 times
HP recovery at 1 | 2 | 3 stacks:
[Healing Rate: 10%] | [Healing Rate: 15%] | [Healing Rate: 20%]

freshness.description:
Cleanses all Hard Control (Stun, Fear, Freeze, Knockup,
Petrify, Sleep), Silence, and 2 DoT effects on the caster
and up to 20 nearby allies. Also heals for [Healing Rate:
60%] HP, applies 1 stack of [Recovery], and prevents the
next 3 Hard Control or Silence effects. The effect lasts 4s.
Can be used while skills are disabled.
[Recovery]: Restores HP every second for 12s, stacking up
to 3 times.
HP recovery at 1 | 2 | 3 stacks
[Healing Rate: 10%] | [Healing Rate: 15%] | [Healing Rate: 20%]

regenerate.description:
Releases restorative energy at the target location, healing
allies. Healing amount increases based on target's
[Recovery] stacks.
[Recovery] stacks: 0|1 |2|3
Recovers HP: [Healing Rate: 75%] | [Healing Rate: 95%] |
[Healing Rate: 115%] | [Healing Rate: 135%]

passive_skill.name: Natural Armor
passive_skill.description:
Gains 1 stack of Natural Armor every 5s, stacking up to 4
times. Each stack increases Damage Resistance by 8%. 1
stack is lost for each instance of damage taken.

leap_strike.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical
Damage to the target.

Can cast [Leap Strike] every 5s.
Charges toward the enemy target, dealing [Damage Rate:
170%] Physical Damage and increasing Attack Speed by
20% for 4s

javelin_throw.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 80%] Physical
Damage to the target.

Performs a [Surging Throw] after 5 Basic Attacks.
Deals [Damage Rate: 180%] Physical Damage and
increases Movement Speed by 20% for 2s

sweeping_strike.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical
Damage to the target.

Can cast [Sweeping Strike] every 5s.
Deals [Damage Rate: 240%] Physical Damage to enemies
in range. Gains 6% Damage Resistance for every enemy
hit, lasting 4s. Stacks up to 5 times.

lance_thrust.description:
Repeatedly thrusts at enemies in a frontal cone, dealing
[Damage Rate: 60%] Physical Damage per hit, then
slashes forward to deal [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical
Damage to enemies in range.

lance_impale.description:
Throws a lance at the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 160%] Physical Damage and reducing Movement
Speed by 25% for 3s to enemies in range.
The lance remains at the target location for 6s. Moving to
its location allows retrieval, granting 20% Movement
Speed and 20% Attack Speed for 4s.
Gains 1 charge every 12s, up to 2 charges

warding_flourish.description:
Channels for 4s, gaining Control Immunity and 60%
Damage Resistance. While channeling, reflects 80%
Physical Damage back to attackers when taking damage.
Deals [Damage Rate: 40%] Physical Damage to nearby
enemies every 0.5s.
Recast again while channeling to charge forward, dealing
[Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage to enemies hit
and reducing their Armor by 20% for 4s.

skyward_lance.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage to enemies
in front and inflicts Knockup for 1s.
Can be recast within 6s to slam down, dealing [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage to enemies in range and
reducing their Movement Speed by 45% for 3s

lance_recall.description:
Instantly removes Control effects, deals [Damage Rate: 280%] Physical Damage to enemies in front, and leaps
back 8m. Increases Movement Speed by 30% for 4s.
Can be used while skills are disabled

passive_skill.name: Spear Scar
passive_skill.description:
Using a weapon skill grants [Spear Scar]: The next 4 Basic
Attacks gain +60% Attack Speed, +2.5m range, and +30%
Lifesteal. This effect lasts 6s.
Also has a 35% chance to grant [Target-based Max HP
15%] Shield for 2s.

sword_slash.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Sword Slash] every 6s. Charges toward an enemy target to deal [Damage Rate: 180%] Physical Damage and inflict 40% Slow for 2s.

sword_cleave.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Sword Cleave] every 5. Deals [Damage Rate: 220%] Physical Damage to surrounding enemies. Grants [Target-based Max HP 3%] Shield for each enemy hit, lasting 4s. Stacks up to 5 times.

sword_energy.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Sword Energy] every 6s. Unleashes sword energy forward, dealing [Damage Rate: 140%] Physical Damage to enemies hit. Increases Movement Speed by 25% for 2s if at least 1 enemy is hit.

vacuum_slash.description: Performs 4 forward slashes, each dealing [Damage Rate: 60%] Physical Damage to players ([Damage Rate: 90%] Physical Damage to mobs). The final hit unleashes sword energy forward, dealing [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage to all enemies hit.

crippling_strike.description: Leaps to the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage and inflicting 50% Slow for 3s to nearby enemies upon landing. Gains [Target-based Max HP 20%] Shield for 4s when hitting at least 1 enemy

power_slash.description: Hold to charge with control immunity and gain +20% Damage Resistance. While charging: Deals [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage and Stuns enemies for 0.5s. After charging for 1.5s, deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage, Stuns fpr 1.5s and creates a ground wave that deals [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage and inflicts 40% Slow for 4s.

defensive_slash.description: Begins Blocking for 3s. While Blocking, reduces Movement Speed but gains control immunity and +70% Damage Resistance. Afterward, deals [Damage Rate: 320%] Physical Damage to nearby enemies and reduces their Armor by 20% for 4s. Block can be canceled early

heart_of_steel.description: Immediately removes all control effects, gains 1 stack of [Sword Momentum], increases Damage Resistance by 25%, and the Attack Speed of the next 3 Basic Attacks by 80% for 8s. Can be used while skills are disabled.

passive_skill.name: Aura and Blade
passive_skill.description: Gains 1 stack of [Momentum] every second while in combat and 2 stacks when dealing damage with Basic Attacks, 4 stacks on Critical Hit, 1 stack when taking Basic Attack Damage, and 2 stacks when taking Skill Damage. At 10 [Momentum] stacks, increases Sword Momentum by 1 level. Momentum lasts 20s. [Sword Momentum]: Each level grants +3% Damage, +4% Attack Speed, and +4% Damage Resistance. Lasts 8s. Grants up to 6 stacks, decaying over time.
